title: Sprint planning dry-runs every paid run a goal names and sets its cap from the estimate before the start gate
goal: When a committed item's goal names a paid run with a spend cap (a smoke record, a probe, a benchmark record), plan step 6 runs its --dry-run on the planning host and records in the item's notes the command, the run count, the sequential runtime and the spend at each pinned model's prices (the claude topic's models.csv); a cap below the estimate is a spend-cap gate asked before the start, not mid-run, and a run too long sequentially gets its parallel-run story before the start. SP-2vhfsn4o: ST-xy5kmisr's goal said --max-usd 5 for a command whose dry run estimated 23.37 USD; the gate came after the code, and the first smoke still spent 26.62 against a 23.37 estimate. SP-hm4qgf3t: ST-ji32ouga's record was sized only during the run (3,150 runs, 20-30 h), so ST-uxgaazfi was filed mid-sprint

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## plan')[1].split('## start')[0];ok=all(w in t for w in ('--dry-run','models.csv','spend cap'));print('plan step sizes paid runs:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
import sys;t=open('kb/_self/backlog.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='models.csv' in t and 'spend cap' in t;print('Plan rule sizes paid runs:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: When a paid command a committed goal names has no --dry-run that estimates it (every benchmarks.py scenario but pool today, BG-wapzksub), what does the plan step do?
options: ask-cap: record 'no estimate' in the item's notes and ask the operator for the spend cap in a gate before the start
refuse: do not commit the item until its command honours --dry-run
gates.recommendation: ask-cap: record 'no estimate' in the item's notes and ask the operator for the spend cap in a gate before the start
gates.answer: ask-cap: record 'no estimate' in the item's notes and ask the operator for the spend cap in a gate before the start

gates.question: Does the dry-run rule get a line in AGENTS.md (4 KB cap, full), or live only in the kb-sprint skill and kb/_self/backlog.md?
options: skill-and-doc: the skill's plan step and backlog.md's Plan rule carry it, AGENTS.md is unchanged at 4069 bytes
agents-line: add a line to AGENTS.md and cut one elsewhere, staying under 4096 bytes (4069 bytes now)
gates.recommendation: skill-and-doc: the skill's plan step and backlog.md's Plan rule carry it, AGENTS.md is unchanged at 4069 bytes
gates.answer: skill-and-doc: the skill's plan step and backlog.md's Plan rule carry it, AGENTS.md is unchanged at 4069 bytes

notes: SP-x7ger6vu close (2026-10-09), accepted by the operator: three mid-run surprises a planning run of the goal's paid commands would have shown: the router-only re-record left pool verify (c) failing on the full record's spend row (ST-4w4yo6ca joined mid-sprint); host-lookups has no effort setting, so ST-fbp5pm6k's 'both levels in one batch' needed a gate mid-run; and benchmarks.py run SCENARIO --dry-run starts paid runs outside pool (BG-wapzksub), so the estimate must come from a scenario that honours it. The planning run uses each paid command's real flags and simulates a partial re-record against pool verify. Merged from ST-tqmayy2h (SP-hm4qgf3t close): ST-ji32ouga's record was sized only during the run (3,150 runs, 20-30 h sequential), so ST-uxgaazfi was filed mid-sprint and its gate g3 (about 140 USD against the 120 USD cap at Sonnet 5.5's price) was asked mid-work. Premise: neither the plan step of .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md nor the Plan rule of kb/_self/backlog.md names a dry run of a paid command or claude/models.csv prices (run 2026-10-10: grep finds none; both checks fail). Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 3 of 13, "Benchmarks: no unplanned paid run, dated model keys, report wording"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence. Gate g2 (answered): AGENTS.md stays unchanged (4069 bytes, 4096 cap); it is in touches only because map.csv maps the skill to it and check warns otherwise.
